# Four-instance live regressions

Recorded on the user's local MuMu farms on September 14, 2026.

The Event Board images show the actual level-9 introduction on port 16448. `text.json` contains Windows OCR observations from those screenshots so regression tests do not depend on an installed OCR language pack. `animated_poster.png` captures another ribbon-animation phase.

`growing.png`, `state.json`, and the single referenced `farming_evidence` image come from the completed two-cycle validated run on port 16416. The evidence retains its original hash and capture metadata. `top_edge.png` and `trees.png` capture the cold-start camera failure before the edge-detection fix.

Production templates under `src/hayday/assets/wheating/event_board` are cropped from these same live introduction screens: pointer, board paper, poster ribbon, information icon, and close icon. The pointer mask excludes its background. No Play Games account screenshot is included in this fixture set.
